summary: LivePerson Inc. filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval at a reconvened special meeting on September 2, 2026, of the Merger Proposal with SoundHound AI, Inc. and its indirect subsidiaries under an Amended and Restated Merger Agreement dated July 2, 2026. The Merger Proposal passed with 6,339,066 votes for, 134,018 against, and 19,874 abstentions. The non-binding compensation advisory proposal was also approved. No price per share or premium was disclosed in the excerpt. All conditions precedent to the transactions and the Notes Restructuring Agreement were satisfied. Watch for closing mechanics and regulatory clearances.
